title: Seam ledger (velocity-matched cuts)
what_it_does: ledger.json lists every cut with exit and entry selector, axis and direction, so a check can verify that motion leaving one scene matches motion entering the next.
when_to_use: Any multi-scene launch composition; run as a check so cuts never sit still.
why: The format is simple and a real quality gain; write our own checker against our scene blocks instead of depending on theirs (they have no standalone checker, the ledger is a document for the agent).
